gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.button..en: Assemble: uses up the core, the soul item and 1 of each material placed
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.button..zh: 组装：核心、灵魂格物品和每格材料各用掉 1 个

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.en: Take the finished gun out of the output slot first
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.zh: 先把输出格里的枪拿走

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.en: Base (B): put the same material in every B slot
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.zh: 枪托（B）：每个 B 格都要放同一种材料

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.en: Handle (H): put the same material in every H slot
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.zh: 握把（H）：每个 H 格都要放同一种材料

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.en: Mechanism (M): put the same material in every M slot
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.zh: 机栓（M）：每个 M 格都要放同一种材料

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.en: The lens slot only takes a matrix projection
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.zh: 透镜格只能放矩阵投影

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.en: Put Sun Imbued Glass in the lens mount
Put the same matrix projection in both lens slots
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.zh: 两个透镜格要放同一种矩阵投影

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.en: The scope slot holds something that isn't a scope
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.zh: 瞄具格里放的不是瞄具

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.en: Put Glass Alloy in the scope mount
Put the same material in both scope (S) slots
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.zh: 两个狙击镜（S）格要放同一种材料

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.en: This gun isn't in the game yet
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.problem.zh: 这种枪还没有加入游戏

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.au.en: Hold to fire: one shot every %s ticks
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.au.zh: 按住连发：每 %s 刻一发

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.sp.en: Hold to spin up for %s s, then one shot every %s tick
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.sp.zh: 按住先空转 %s 秒，之后每 %s 刻一发

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.re.en: Reload: %s s, then a %s s cooldown
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.re.zh: 装填：%s 秒，装完再冷却 %s 秒

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.du.en: Durability: %s shots; once worn out, 1 in 4 shots jams
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.du.zh: 耐久：%s 发，磨损满了每发有 1/4 几率卡壳

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.so.en: Holds %s MRU from the soul slot (up to %s)
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.stat.so.zh: 枪里带着 %s MRU（从灵魂格转来，最多 %s）

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.ou.en: Press Done and the gun appears here
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.ou.zh: 点「完成」，枪就出现在这里

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.so.en: Used up when you assemble; the MRU stored in it goes into the new gun (up to %s)
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.so.zh: 组装时用掉，里面存的 MRU 转进新枪（最多 %s）

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.sa.en: Same item in every slot of this kind: %s
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.sa.zh: 这类格子每格放同一种：%s

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.le.en: Changes the ray's color and adds an on-hit effect
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.le.zh: 改变射线的颜色，打中时附带效果

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.sc.en: Sneak while holding the gun to zoom in
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.sc.zh: 拿着枪潜行时放大视野

gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.ba.en: Mostly decides reload time, fire rate and shots per load
gui.essentialcraft5.weapon_maker.slot.ba.zh: 主要决定装填、射击间隔和弹量
